variables.scientific_description: Temperature of the uppermost layer of the ocean (skin temperature ~10-20 microns from satellite radiometer, bulk equivalent). Controls metabolic rate, distribution boundary, and thermal preference of pelagic fish.
variables.provenance: Data-derived from satellite radiometry (MODIS-Aqua L3 SMI)
variables.relevance_prigi: Indicator of seasonal upwelling in South Java. Drops to 25.5-26.5 degC during peak southeast monsoon (June-August).

variables.scientific_description: Deviation of sea surface temperature from the 11-year monthly climatological mean. Positive values indicate warm anomalies (El Nino / positive IOD conditions); negative values indicate enhanced upwelling cooling.
Concentration of photosynthetic pigment in phytoplankton. Serves as primary indicator of marine primary productivity and basis of the pelagic marine food web.
variables.caution_note: Strictly labeled as primary productivity indicator; NOT direct proof of fish abundance or verified feeding activity.
variables.provenance: Data-derived from satellite ocean color (MODIS-Aqua L3 SMI)

variables.scientific_description: Spatial horizontal temperature gradient. Fronts demarcate boundaries between cold upwelled water and warmer offshore water masses, acting as aggregation zones for zooplankton and pelagic schooling fish.

variables.formula: Delta_T_co(m, y) = SST_offshore(m, y) - SST_coastal(m, y)
variables.scientific_description: Temperature contrast between offshore oceanic waters (south of -9.5 S) and coastal neritic waters of Prigi (north of -8.6 S). Serves as a diagnostic surface thermal contrast indicator (distinct from Bakun wind-stress Coastal Upwelling Index).

Seafloor topography and inclination derived from multi-source compilation. Continental slope (150-1200m / shelf-break 200-1000m) serves as the bathymetric screening envelope for voluntary shark bycatch review.
variables.provenance: Data-derived from GEBCO 2023 & ETOPO1 (multi-source composite without single uniform vertical datum)

variables.scientific_description: Meridional (north-south cross-shore) Ekman volume transport per unit width driven by zonal wind stress tau_x along the east-west trending South Java coast.
